headline: PLAICRAFT's first report card: 4 human phone takes replay-verify 100%
lede: With the read key finally in place, the lanes graded every stored session themselves — and the store's human play passed replay and voice across the board, with a verdict-semantics fix making sure an untested thing never looks like a broken thing.

notes.text: plaicraft:grade posted 7 PLAIGRADE verdicts on #1711 — 4 native-human iPhone takes replay-verify 100% with voice PASS (seed30, 42, 16, 19); the three Nov-11 takes fail honestly (voice clock off, model-labeled seats). This is the evidence the big-build audit asked for.

PR #2304: a take whose audio contains no clap test now reads n-a — not clap-tested — instead of a misleading FAIL; claps-heard-with-no-taps stays FAIL, with the laundering mutant killed by two named pins (self-test 25/25).

Two takes pass the voice gate with >1 s clock drift (likely mic-open offset). The ±50 ms line is the clap test's job — Jon's one slap at the clap test closes it, and jonq #2305 carries the last store-config step (the write key).
